title: Find why the 10-minute config republish exists and pin the chosen behaviour with a failing-first test
goal: The reason is recorded and a test that fails without the chosen behaviour is committed first
acceptance: Why: git log -S publishAllConfigs on apps/hub/src/hub.ts (F-007, fed6e9f) and the F-007 record are cited in B-012; the comment's reason (calendar-driven light phases) is confirmed against Lights

Decision recorded in B-012: keep the periodic resend (and whether it also covers recovery after a lost retained message or broker restart, tested if so) or replace it; the owner is asked only if recovery behaviour is unclear

A test is committed first that fails without the chosen behaviour (fake timers: after one interval every agent's config is republished; or the replacement path delivers a phase change to the agent) and passes with the code
privacy: Neutral invented fixtures only; no personal data, credentials or private reports in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
If the resend turns out to be needed for recovery in a way the design does not cover, the owner decides the behaviour before the test is written

effort.basis: One interval test with fake timers plus reading one commit. Estimated 2026-11-26. Not a measurement.
